name: Physical Fitness
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of physical strength and endurance as part of a believer's stewardship of the body, seen in Proverbs 31:17 where strength is actively cultivated. Isaiah 40:31 highlights that true renewal of strength comes from waiting on the Lord, enabling believers to persevere without weariness. Romans 12:1 calls believers to present their bodies as a living sacrifice, underscoring physical fitness as a reasonable act of worship. Additionally, Philippians 4:13 reminds us that Christ empowers us in all things, including maintaining bodily strength, while Hebrews 12:11 teaches that disciplined exercise, though challenging, produces righteousness and peace.
